timeline_by_date.summary: Experiment started. Packaged existing bank data warehouse / SQL interview-story material into a 109 RMB Xianyu service offer, published the first listing, prepared/sent X/Twitter CTA material, and created revenue verification rules. Views appeared but no inquiry, order, or verified revenue occurred.
timeline_by_date.lesson: A live listing and early views are not revenue; evidence rules are needed before counting anything.

timeline_by_date.summary: Expanded from one Xianyu listing into multiple urgent-office offers, improved night-rush visuals, added a morning/same-day urgent offer, and tightened X/Twitter outreach and conversion material. No-inquiry thresholds triggered pivot rules.
timeline_by_date.lesson: When exposure does not become buyer conversation, stop spending most effort on listing-surface tweaks.

timeline_by_date.summary: Broadened into active acquisition and task marketplaces. The 19 RMB diagnostic Xianyu funnel appeared deleted/unavailable and cannot complete the goal alone. GitHub/Boss/Algora/Opire screens found no clean fixed-cash low-competition task. Tieba and public buyer-intent searches were low-yield or unstable. ZBJ service was published but no buyer/order appeared. EPWK showed demand but was blocked by paid bid chances, membership/skill tags, CAPTCHA, account timing, or detail gates.
timeline_by_date.lesson: Marketplace demand can be real but unusable when the free participation path is blocked.

timeline_by_date.summary: Old surfaces kept producing exposure but no conversion. PeoplePerHour and X/Twitter produced possible write candidates earlier. Later Freelancer screens made REDACTED_MARKETPLACE_PROJECT_ID the best Excel-first confirmed-write candidate, while REDACTED_MARKETPLACE_PROJECT_ID became the best adjacent Office/PDF route if the user permits a non-Excel-only Freelancer attempt. Local proposal previews, execution checklists, and sample assets were prepared, but no marketplace write action, login, bid, message, upload, inquiry, order, payout, or revenue occurred.
timeline_by_date.lesson: The next meaningful move needs explicit user confirmation for a write/account action, or a genuinely fresh read-only free-path discovery.

support_policy.public_repo_privacy_rule: Do not store payer names, account identifiers, full transaction IDs, payment screenshots, tax records, private accounting ledgers, or private payment details in the public repository.

hard_boundaries: Do not count views, favorites, posts, proposal drafts, prepared materials, platform setup, tips, donations, support payments, or inquiries without order/payment as experiment revenue.
Do not solve CAPTCHA or ask for verification codes inside an automated maintenance task.
Do not pay for bids, membership, promotion, deposit, guarantee, or platform credits without explicit user confirmation.
Do not alter payment, tax, profile, contact, or account settings without explicit user confirmation.
Do not fabricate experience, promise guaranteed outcomes, or provide real bank/company internal materials.
Do not upload sample assets unless attachment use is separately approved.
next_safe_plan: Keep existing Xianyu, X/Twitter, Tieba, ZBJ, and EPWK surfaces as low-frequency monitors only.
If the user explicitly confirms Freelancer REDACTED_MARKETPLACE_PROJECT_ID, use its prepared execution checklist before any submit button.
If the user explicitly confirms Freelancer REDACTED_MARKETPLACE_PROJECT_ID, use its prepared execution checklist before any submit button.
Attach sample assets only with separate explicit user approval.
Stop for login, CAPTCHA, ID/KYC, phone/SMS, payment, tax, profile/contact setup, membership/deposit gates, video-call requirements, or private workbook/customer/staff/sales/financial/document data.
If a real buyer appears, stop broad searching and route the buyer toward a compliant on-platform order.
If payment or payout appears, verify evidence before updating revenue_ledger.csv.
